550:t_1:335.en:
$$マオ$$
「Everyone... This isn't like me, but let me say a few words too.」

550:t_1:336.en:
$$マオ$$
「We've been through hell since the $$時獄戦役$$ ended...」

550:t_1:337.en:
$$桂$$
「That's right... $$サイデリアル$$ suddenly took Earth from us...」

550:t_1:338.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Our desperate attack on $$ラース・バビロン$$ ended in total defeat...」

550:t_1:339.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「And after being thrown to the galactic center, we came right back to the solar system for one battle after another.」

550:t_1:340.en:
$$マオ$$
「But I just can't stand the thought of losing here.」

550:t_1:341.en:
$$マオ$$
「Well... He went on ahead of us, so he'll be lonely for a while.」

550:t_1:342.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「Heh... If he's watching us from the afterlife, he's probably saying any operation he can't shine in should fail.」

550:t_1:345.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「Yeah... He's probably especially jealous of me.」

550:t_1:346.en:
$$マオ$$
「Then why don't we disappoint $$クルツ$$?」

550:t_1:349.en:
$$マオ$$
「Let's do this, everyone! Let's disappoint $$クルツ$$!」

550:t_1:351.en:
$$マオ$$
($$クルツ$$... You can be useful for more than sniping, can't you...?)

550:t_1:352.en:
$$マオ$$
(We're heading out... Sorry, but pray for us not to join you over there...)

550:t_2:3.en: ～$$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$　Hangar～

550:t_2:5.en:
$$宗介$$
「I'm fine! There's no fire either!」

550:t_2:9.en:
$$サックス$$
「I'm sorry, $$相良$$... The $$レーバテイン$$... isn't even... online yet...」

550:t_2:10.en:
$$宗介$$
「Hold on, Lieutenant! I'll stop the bleeding right away!」

550:t_2:11.en:
$$サックス$$
「I'm... finished... It's my own body... I know...」

550:t_2:13.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「What the hell are you saying, Boss!?」

550:t_2:14.en:
$$宗介$$
「I won't... let you die here!」

550:t_2:16.en:
$$サックス$$
「The $$レーバテイン$$... $$アル$$ has his external power disconnected while we add to the motion manager's data bus.」

550:t_2:17.en:
$$サックス$$
「If $$アル$$ doesn't wake up, deactivate the added lines. Ask $$ピニオン$$ if you don't know how...」

550:t_2:19.en:
$$サックス$$
「It isn't what matters...? What good is a soldier who doesn't carry out his mission!?」

550:t_2:21.en:
$$サックス$$
「Just as you stake your lives on your missions, we stake ours on maintenance...」

550:t_2:22.en:
$$サックス$$
「If you do what I said, you'll have to... give up on the emergency deployment booster... but the machine itself... should... work...」

550:t_2:24.en:
$$サックス$$
「Hah... It ended up like this... but I did... everything I could...」

550:t_2:25.en:
$$サックス$$
「I... don't hold... a grudge... against anyone......」

550:t_2:28.en:
$$宗介$$
「$$ピニオン$$... I'm counting on you to take care of the Lieutenant.」

550:t_2:32.en:
$$宗介$$
「Test the emergency deployment booster's connection! Hurry!」

550:t_2:33.en:
$$アル$$
「First, I have a question. Lieutenant $$サックス$$...」

550:t_2:34.en:
$$宗介$$
「The Lieutenant... was killed in action.」

550:t_2:35.en:
$$アル$$
「Are you saying the maintenance company commander, Lieutenant $$エドワード・サックス$$, died during the operation?」

550:t_2:36.en:
$$宗介$$
「That's correct. He died in the attack on the ship just now.」

550:t_2:37.en:
$$アル$$
「I understand. Thank you for explaining.」

550:t_2:38.en:
$$アル$$
「Then I will begin the connection test.」

550:t_2:39.en:
$$宗介$$
「It isn't working... The secondary control circuit for the auxiliary wings isn't responding.」

550:t_2:41.en:
$$宗介$$
「This equipment was installed in a rush. Malfunctions are inevitable.」

550:t_2:42.en:
$$アル$$
「No... I mean Lieutenant $$サックス$$.」

550:t_2:44.en:
$$アル$$
「Was he so busy getting me online that he neglected his own safety?」

550:t_2:45.en:
$$宗介$$
(Does $$アル$$ feel responsible for $$サックス$$'s death...?)

550:t_2:46.en:
$$宗介$$
(No, however skillfully he talks to humans, he's a machine...)

550:t_2:47.en:
$$宗介$$
(If he were asking to assess the tactical impact, I could understand...)

550:t_2:49.en:
$$宗介$$
「Why are you asking that? Are you worried about something?」

550:t_2:51.en:
$$アル$$
「Now that I am successfully online, the loss of Lieutenant $$サックス$$ as a mechanic barely diminishes our fighting strength.」

550:t_2:52.en:
$$アル$$
「It is not a cause for concern.」

550:t_2:55.en:
$$アル$$
「I feel a much greater loss.」

550:t_2:57.en:
$$アル$$
「He looked after me since I was in the $$アーバレスト$$. He was one of the people who knew my body best.」

550:t_2:58.en:
$$アル$$
「He will never inspect me or speak to me again... This loss far exceeds the strategic level.」
